summary_points: Document No: 4521-CAL-AEE-75-52-0002-GAR for Job No.: Drain back tank pit at Solana Generating Station.
Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle allows for non-standard billing cycles upon request.
Confidential information must not be reproduced without permission from ABENER TEYMA SOLANA.
Revisions include updates to IBC reference and contract terms.
Table of Contents outlines sections on Overview, Description, References, Codes, Design Basis, Loads, Results, Load Combinations, and Reinforced Concrete Pit.
Drain Back tank pit designed for Solana Generating Station.
Pit dimensions: 24’11”x 15’9”, inner height 10’6”, slab thickness 3’0”.
Supported over subbase with type A1 or A3 compacted material.
Steel structure anchored by post-installed bolts on the slab.
Design based on static finite elements analysis using shell elements.
Materials chosen considering soil sulfate concentration and water level.
Codes and normative include IBC 2012, ASCE 7-05, ACI-318, and API 650.
Ground bearing capacity is 3.000 psf according to Geothecnical Report.
Test boring PB-09 and PB-11 indicate an average of 25 to 30 blows per foot, resulting in a ground bearing capacity of 2.850 – 3.400 psf.
Safety factors for concrete and steel are based on ACI-318 and ANSI/AISC 360-05 (LRFD).
Dead load includes reinforced concrete elements, steel elements, drain tank, and pump.
Live load includes water in the maximum capacity of the tank.
The document is a calculation report for the Solana Generating Station project.
It includes information on alternate billing cycles and confidential terms.
Ground pressure calculations are provided for static and dynamic conditions.
Static active earth pressure formula: Pstatic = γHKAE.
Dynamic active earth pressure formula: Pdynamic = γHKAD.
Earth pressure (static) calculation results in Pmax = 448 lb/ft².
Document No: 4521-CAL-AEE-75-52-0002-GAR for Job No.: Drain back tank pit Project: Solana Generating Station

Rebar quantity determined by ACI 318 specifications using rectangular diagram method
Footing reinforced with a minimum of 1.8 ‰ per each side as indicated in ACI-318
Wall reinforcement based on ACI-318 table 11.6.1
Calculation report for Solana Generating Station
Analysis of foundation using CYPECAD and SAP2000 software
Load combinations defined based on project situations
